about: Modwerk source-only midi-engine package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/midi-engine.

mods.title: MIDI Engine
mods.summary: A machine that sequences an external synth from a Rytm track: notes, chords, pitch bend, mod wheel, pressure and six CC lanes, all lockable.
mods.description: A machine that sequences an external synth from a Rytm track: notes, chords, pitch bend, mod wheel, pressure and six CC lanes, all lockable.
mods.author: svindler
mods.on_unit: Builds ME09 to ME17 ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 over DIN and USB; this package, compiled with GCC 16.2 from the same C, ran as build MER1 on the same unit on 2026-11-17: notes, chords, lanes, PB, MW and AT and leaving the machine as on ME17.
